_notes: Grey-box test board for Milestone 3. The final Chapter 1 board is set later.
cards: evidence ids (from data/evidence/evidence_registry.json). A card only shows if the player holds that evidence. Order sets the default grid position, so do not reorder after release.
reaction_name: name shown above the text-only reaction lines.
links[].pair: two evidence ids, in any order. deduction is the short tag on the locked string, line is what is said when it locks.
wrong_reactions[].pair: a wrong pair that gets its own line. Any other wrong pair uses fallback_reactions in turn.
already_linked_line: said when the player tries a pair that is already locked.
title: CASE BOARD - Chapter 1

links.line: Two light sources, and a snowbank nobody recorded that night. Someone built this scene.
